Humanoids

FF introduces $2,490 Nova and $299 Nova Mini education robots

Nova starts with an invitation-only 100-unit release and developer tools; Mini’s curriculum is sold separately.

PRNewswire ↗16 October 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 3

Hardware and learning packages

FF EAI Robotics and Faraday Future introduced Nova for developers and educators at $2,490, with a $390 Developer Skills Package. Nova Mini costs $299, while its accompanying curriculum costs $499. Device prices therefore need to be distinguished from additional learning products.

Hardware and development tools

The companies specify 20 degrees of freedom, LiDAR, wide-angle vision, depth sensing and a microphone array for Nova. It can walk or use a detachable base for autonomous navigation. Development support includes an SDK, a ROS 2 workflow and reinforcement learning through NVIDIA Isaac before policies are tested on hardware.

A phased release

The first phase is limited to 100 invited buyers, with the first 20 units described as ready for immediate delivery. Applicants must be selected before ordering; broader developer and consumer releases follow later. Mini targets ages eight and up with block programming. These are manufacturer specifications, not independent durability results.
